procedural_matters: GER 220411 was represented by Pia Christin CONRADI.
FRA 227246 was represented by Périne MILLERET.
Ben Koppelaar (coach of GER 220411) attended the hearing as an observer
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: The conditions at the time of incidents were 5 knots of sea breeze and small chop.
GER 220411 and FRA 227246 were approaching Mark 2p for the second rounding with GER 220411 and FRA 227246 on starboard tack and with FRA 227246 clear astern of GER 220411.
GER 220411 Gybed to port between 15 and 20 meters from mark 2p and became instantlyoverlapped with FRA 227246 on starboard and on converging courses.
When GER 220411 entered the zone FRA 227246 was inside overlapped with GER at about two boat lengths lateral distance.
FRA 227246 Gybed to port and rounded the mark inside of GER 220411. 6. There was no contact between the boats or between FRA 227246 and mark 2p. 7 No boats took penalty turns.
conclusions: GER outside overlapped at thezone gave FRA mark-room, as required 18.2(a)(1).
decision: The protest is dismissed, no rules broken
